chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ahmad ibn al-Walid narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar narrated to us, saying: Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah narrated to us, saying: Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Abbas ibn al-Fadl ibn al-Abbas ibn Rabi'ah ibn al-Harith ibn Abd al-Muttalib narrated to us, from Sabbah ibn Khaqan, from Amr ibn Uthman al-Tamimi the judge, who said: The Commander of the Believers, Allah's prayers be upon him, went out to his companions while they were discussing manliness.

He said: Where are you from the Book of Allah? They said: O Commander of the Believers, in which place? He said: In His saying, Exalted and Glorious is He: 'Indeed, Allah commands to justice and good deed.' Justice is fairness, and good deed is bestowment.
ai.seo_question: What is the definition of justice and good deed according to Imam Ali in this hadith?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Ma'ani al-Akhbar*, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) grounds the ethical concept of *muru'ah* (manliness/virtue) in the Quranic command of 'justice and benevolence' (Surah An-Nahl 16:90). He provides a precise jurisprudential distinction, defining *al-adl* as fairness or giving each their due, while *al-ihsan* represents the voluntary act of generosity or bestowal beyond obligation. This interpretation highlights the Shia scholarly emphasis on combining strict equity with graciousness as the core of moral character.

en.basel-kadem: 1.	We were told by Muhammed bin Hasan bin Ahmad bin Waleed, that he said: We were told by Muhammed bin Hasan al-Saffar, that he said: We were told by Ahmad bin Abi Abdillah, that he said: We were told by Abdul-Rahman bin Abbas bin Fadl bin Abbas ibn Rabee’a bin Harith bin Abdul-Muttalib, from Sabah bin Khaqan, from Amru bin Uthman al-Taimi, the judge, that he said: The Commander of the Believers, Allah’s blessings be upon him, went out to his companions while they were mentioning manliness,

and he said: Where are you from the Book of Allah? They said: O Commander of the Believers, which spot? He said: In the saying of Him, Exalted and Glorious is He: «Indeed, Allah commands to justice and good deed» [16:90]. Justice is fairness, and good deed is bestowment.
